summary: Full validation of FortexaRH Subscription module billing-cycle improvements: pending invoice auto-generation cron, idempotency, suspension after GRACE_DAYS=3, /billing/status + /billing/pay-pending endpoints, /api/invoices listing of pending, Stripe Checkout URL creation, payment_transactions.invoice_id contract for webhook, frontend banner + Pagar buttons on /subscriptions, /billing-required page, ProtectedRoute auto-redirect when suspended, and logout cleanup. 8/8 backend tests passed; all 4 frontend flows passed.

issues: Estado badge label shows in current UI language (e.g. 'Pending' when EN). Spec mentions 'Pagado / Pendiente' (Spanish); using i18n keys subscriptions.paid/pending is acceptable but verify Spanish translations are defined in es.json so users in ES locale see the Spanish labels
Plan status badge renders raw value 'past_due' instead of a localized friendly label like 'Vencido / Past due'

action_items: (Optional) Localize the past_due / suspended badge labels in the Current Plan card on /subscriptions
(Optional) Confirm i18n keys subscriptions.paid and subscriptions.pending exist in es.json so Spanish locale renders 'Pagado'/'Pendiente'
critical_code_review_comments: billing_cycle.py uses next_period_start = period_end (good) and stores period_start_iso for idempotency check — works as long as period_end isn't mutated.

suspend_overdue_subscriptions uses string comparison on ISO timestamps which is correct only because both are UTC ISO 8601 with same offset format — safe but brittle if any record uses a different ISO offset.
BillingRequiredPage.jsx redirects loaded users back to /dashboard when has_pending=false AND is_blocked=false — good fallback so the page can't be accessed unnecessarily.
ProtectedRoute polls /billing/status on every protected route mount; consider caching the result in a context to avoid request bursts when navigating quickly across pages.
seed_data_creation: Did NOT create new data. Temporarily set subscription.status='suspended' to verify ProtectedRoute redirect, then restored to status='past_due' with past_due_since=now. Pending invoice inv_da7bd3cd01e7 (FRH-202605-C7D4F4, $29.00) is preserved so subsequent runs still see the pending banner.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All billing-cycle features verified end-to-end. Subscription is restored to past_due with pending invoice intact. Stripe is in LIVE mode — never click through to actual payment; only validate that POST /api/billing/pay-pending returns a checkout_url starting with https://checkout.stripe.com. To re-test the suspend redirect, set subscriptions.status='suspended' via Mongo, log in, then restore to 'past_due'.
verified_flows: GET /api/billing/status returns has_pending=true with full pending_invoice payload + subscription_status=past_due + grace_days_left
POST /api/billing/pay-pending returns a valid Stripe LIVE checkout URL and inserts payment_transactions with invoice_id + payment_status='initiated'
run_billing_cycle() is idempotent (two calls produce same pending invoice count)
suspend_overdue_subscriptions() flips past_due (>3 days) to suspended and sets suspended_at
GET /api/invoices includes pending invoice with status='pending'
Frontend /subscriptions shows pending-invoice-banner + pending-invoice-pay-btn; clicking redirects to Stripe (window.location navigates away)
InvoiceHistory pending row shows pay-invoice-inv_da7bd3cd01e7 green 'Pagar' button
/billing-required renders billing-required-card with invoice details ($29, FRH-202605-C7D4F4) and billing-pay-now-btn
billing-logout-btn clears localStorage token and navigates to /login
